release_notes: Movement and interface overhaul: calibrated continuous tilt steering with recenter, inversion, sensitivity and swipe fallback; faster 18–20 m/s starts; climbs, crests and descents; one selected character for the entire run; cinematic opening and revised Play hub/HUD. Adds lit character surfaces, embroidered cloth, weathered paving and layered 3D architecture. All 630 gameplay assertions passed in GitHub CI; each character completed an automated 1.31 km run without damage, deaths or handoffs. This development alpha still requires physical-phone tilt/performance testing and further authored art to meet the owner’s premium visual target.
